evals.prompt: Show me how to call the orchestration service with a prompt template in Python
evals.expected_output: Agent generates a working Python example using sap-ai-sdk-gen that calls the orchestration service with a prompt template containing input variables.
assertions: Generated code imports from sap-ai-sdk-gen (not generative-ai-hub-sdk)
Generated code uses OrchestrationService and OrchestrationConfig
Prompt template includes at least one {{?variable}} placeholder
Agent includes the uv add sap-ai-sdk-gen install command or equivalent setup step

evals.prompt: Add Azure content filtering to my orchestration pipeline
evals.expected_output: Agent generates a Python example that extends an orchestration pipeline with Azure content filtering applied to both input and output.
assertions: Generated code imports AzureContentFilter from sap-ai-sdk-gen
Content filtering is applied to both input and output of the pipeline
At least one content category (Hate, Violence, Sexual, or SelfHarm) is configured with a threshold
Generated code is runnable with uv run

evals.prompt: Show me how to call the orchestration service with a prompt template using curl
evals.expected_output: Agent provides a working curl command that calls the orchestration /v2/completion endpoint with a prompt template, including how to get the Bearer token and resource group.
assertions: curl command includes Authorization: Bearer header with a token
Request body includes a {{?variable}} placeholder in the prompt template
Agent shows how to obtain the Bearer token (e.g. get_token.py script or TOKEN env var)
